📌 Tehran, IRNA - Foreign ministers from 18 Arab and Islamic nations strongly condemned the Israeli deadly airstrike on Nasser Medical Complex in Gaza, which led to casualties among patients and medical staff.

​
They warned that the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza is set to worsen as winter approaches, posing grave risks to the lives of civilians.
​
The foreign ministers of Qatar, Jordan, the UAE, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, Algeria, Djibouti, Saudi Arabia, Sudan, Somalia, Oman, Palestine, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Egypt, and Mauritania signed this statement.
​
At least six people were killed, and over 30 were injured in the Zionist regime’s recent attack on the Nasser hospital in Gaza.
